## Changes since v3 (Financial Correctness & Model Calibration)

Version 4 incorporates foundational quantitative finance fixes, empirical market calibrations, and real balance-sheet integration across Module B:
1. **Bond Spread Duration Sign Convention**: Fixed sign convention in bond revaluation ($\Delta P \approx -D_{spread} \cdot \Delta s \cdot P$); positive spread widening now correctly causes bond capital losses.
2. **Credit Default Triangle Alignment**: Aligned credit default triangle to $\Delta s \approx (1 - R) \cdot \Delta PD \implies \Delta PD = \frac{\Delta s}{1 - R}$ and $\Delta ECL = EAD \cdot (1 - R) \cdot \Delta PD = EAD \cdot \Delta s$.
3. **Rating-Tiered Spread Shocks**: Anchored spreads to FRED / ICE BofA rating OAS series (AAA through CCC) with Damodaran synthetic credit ratings and S&P Global Ratings Default Study baseline PDs.
4. **Macro Polarity & Conservative Provisioning**: Macro sentiment direction accurately recognizes policy easing as positive; loan provision releases during rallies are strictly floored at 0 ($\Delta ECL \le 0 \implies 0$) while mark-to-market bonds appreciate.
5. **Real Issuer Wholesale Book**: Replaced purely synthetic issuers with 22 real S&P 100 debt issuers across all 11 GICS sectors reconstructed from SEC EDGAR XBRL filings.
6. **Contagion & M&A Calibration**: M&A shocks apply strictly to debt-issuing acquirers; contagion propagates across customer-supplier and equity residual networks.

### Before vs After Calibration Stress Scenario Comparison

| Stress Scenario | v3 Baseline P&L | v4 Calibrated P&L | v4 P&L (% Funded) | v3 Valuation Pathology | v4 Calibrated Valuation & Methodology |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **COVID-19 Crash (2020)** | -$84.2M | **-$46.36M** | -7.60% | Inflated loan ECL from inverted triangle ($\times 2.22$ factor) | Rating-tiered OAS spread widening; Wholesale -$25.54M, Equity -$18.45M, Retail -$2.25M |
| **Fed Rate Shock (Jun 2022)** | -$22.1M | **-$11.33M** | -1.86% | Flat un-anchored spread across all rating buckets | Duration-matched rates shock with rating multipliers; Wholesale -$6.33M, Equity -$4.74M, Retail -$0.29M |
| **Fed Pivot / Easing (Dec 2023)** | -$14.5M (erroneous loss) | **+$16.58M** | +2.72% | Inverted macro polarity; easing treated as negative shock | Macro easing recognized; Bond MTM appreciation +$10.32M, Equity +$6.39M, Loan ECL release floored at $0 |
| **Russia-Ukraine War (2022)** | -$3.9M | **-$1.88M** | -0.31% | Broad unnormalized sector impact | GICS sector normalization; Energy/Commodities preserved, Wholesale -$1.00M, Equity -$0.74M |
| **SVB Weekend Shock (Mar 2023)** | -$8.4M | **-$0.37M** | -0.06% | Fictional regional bank names; substring sector matching | Sector-specific shock hitting real Financials issuers and retail deposits; Wholesale +$1.00M, Equity -$1.02M |
| **PS Benchmark (Eq -10%, Rates +200bp)** | -$32.8M | **-$21.46M** | -3.52% | Bond duration sign reversal | Bond duration capital loss (-$16.29M) + Equity decline (-$5.47M) + Swap DV01 (+300k MTM) |
